value.rationale: The result isolates the independent inner-path budget in an explicitly published sample-reuse strategy and gives a quantitative limit on what outer drift sampling can achieve, even when the true sensitivity matrix is rank one. The exact distribution and best one-direction prediction-risk formula are structural, not just a trivial finite matrix rank observation. It provides a reproducible design benchmark and a precise boundary of applicability without claiming failure for arbitrary drifts or complete numerical schemes.
